entities.name: Uu Relay RLC Channel Config
entities.description: Configuration information for Uu Relay RLC channels received in the Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToAddModList IE.

entities.name: Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToAddModList IE
entities.description: Information element containing a list of Uu Relay RLC channel configurations to add or modify.

entities.name: uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID
entities.description: Identifier for a Uu Relay RLC channel within a cell group.

entities.name: RLC Entity
entities.description: Radio Link Control entity that handles RLC layer operations for Uu relay channels.

entities.name: Logical Channel
entities.description: MAC logical channel configured for Uu relay communication.

entities.name: Existing Uu Relay RLC Channel Condition
entities.description: Condition where a Uu Relay RLC channel with the same uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID already exists in the current configuration within the same cell group.

entities.name: New Uu Relay RLC Channel Condition
entities.description: Condition where a Uu Relay RLC channel with the given uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID was not previously configured within the same cell group.

entities.name: reestablishRLC Condition
entities.description: Condition where the reestablishRLC parameter is received in the configuration.

relations.description: The Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToAddModList IE contains Uu Relay RLC channel configurations.
Uu Relay RLC Channel Config contains the uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID identifier.
When an existing channel is found, the reestablishRLC condition determines if RLC re-establishment is performed.
If reestablishRLC is received, the RLC entity is re-established as per TS 38.322.
For existing channels, the RLC entity is reconfigured according to the received rlc-Config.
For existing channels, the logical channel is reconfigured according to the received mac-LogicalChannelConfig.
For new channels, an RLC entity is established according to the received rlc-Config.
For new channels, a logical channel is configured in the MAC entity according to the received mac-LogicalChannelConfig.
